name: presik
description: Live in-class quizzes for interactive lectures: students answer from their phones, the projector shows the question and result, and arrow keys drive your slides and the quiz in sync. Bring any deck — Marp, PDF, PowerPoint, or Keynote — and presik renders it with the quiz interleaved, in class or over Zoom. Runs locally; the engine is separate from content (courses/slides/questions).
